Re-routed to enter the strip further right (150,152), clear of the caption's text span. No renderer change needed - this was a coordinate choice, not a capability gap.

notesForReusableSystem: Second scene in a row where a straight-line arrow needed manual rerouting to avoid crossing a label or another shape (case01: arrows through a stacked strip; case02: an arrow through the target's own caption). Neither was a capability gap - both were fixed by moving coordinates - but there is no assistance in the vocabulary for catching an arrow/label collision before a render is inspected by eye. Watching whether this becomes frequent enough to justify a reusable check (e.g. a dev-time warning when an authored arrow's bounding box intersects another object's label rect).
